dataset.design: paired LPS-stimulated (NAR) vs unstimulated (NNAR), FM cases vs HC

TACR1.verdict: nominal but effect ~0.03 log2 — biologically negligible

CXCL8.verdict: replicates parent p=0.0096 — positive control PASS

pipeline_validation.note: Independent re-pairing by donor E-code (36/41 pairs vs parent 13/18) reproduces parent findings: CXCL8 p=0.0053 vs 0.0096, IL1B direction consistent. Pipeline cross-check PASS.
pipeline_validation.pairing_fix: tar member names carry 'Aligned' suffix; initial pairing failed silently (0 pairs) until suffix stripped

kill_criterion.metric: at least 1 NEW axis gene (MRGPRX2 or CMA1) with blunting p<0.05 after Bonferroni (n=6, threshold 0.0083)
kill_criterion.verdict: KILL: MRGPRX2/TAC1 axis not differentially LPS-responsive in FM neutrophils

biological_caveat.tissue_mismatch: GSE334369 is neutrophils; MRGPRX2 is primarily a mast-cell receptor (skin/mucosa DRG proximity). Low basal expression (58/205 samples nonzero TPM) limits power. A null here does NOT kill the mast-cell compartment hypothesis — it kills THIS dataset as a test of it.
biological_caveat.honest_scope: Negative result is dataset-scoped, not axis-scoped

conclusion_for_eidos: Handoff accepted and executed as cheap falsification gate FIRST: axis genes are null in this dataset. GSE334369 cannot test MRGPRX2 (wrong tissue). If the TAC1/MRGPRX2 line continues, it needs a mast-cell or skin/DRG dataset — not more neutrophil data.
